notes.text: Completed a second reading of this assigned sheet only. The original and each native half were viewed once, followed by eight existing crops. No new crop, enlarged half, OCR, external research or TeX compilation was used. Accepted text and both witnesses were treated as candidates.

The complete proposed fragment differs from the accepted page only at the small-varphi index and the last marginal suspension count. Both remain explicitly uncertain. No original MARKS decision was changed and no new MARKS ID was created.

M0652 and M0654–M0657 remain unsettled. The word tentatively transcribed traits and the local/henselian phrase were not supplied from mathematical expectations. The final possible bar remains entangled with the preceding prose.

The sheet asserts compatibility of maps (22) and (23), with the action on T(overlined Q) through Gamma taken into account; section 5 introduces J and its preserving subgroup. These statements were read as source claims, not proved.

The pale 4 and 7 are preserved without identifying the pagination hand or explaining the two numbering systems. The oblique marginal note is source writing, but this audit makes no new author attribution.
